fullPassage: Property rights are key determinants of natural resource use. When a natural resource is not scarce relative to the existing demand, the rights to use it are generally irrelevant. If changes occur that render the resource economically scarce, however, e.g., shifts in preferences, technology, or demographics, rights to use the resource begin to matter and a process whereby property rights evolve may be set in motion. It is useful to think of this process in terms of supply and demand forces. The demand for property rights arises when groups or individuals realize that their welfare would be enhanced if the current property rights system were changed. Imagine a renewable natural resource used by a village under open access conditions in which demand is low relative to the yield the resource can sustain, so common pool losses are minimal. An exogenous change then occurs that dramatically increases demand, e.g., a technological innovation or trade liberalization that creates a demand for the resource as an input. If open access persists, each individual's increased use of the resource would now adversely affect use by others, causing welfare losses. Users now have an incentive to “demand” a change in the property rights system, to a form that avoids these losses. This observation applies more generally: most market failures, such as externalities, public goods, and asymmetric information, afford the possibility to increase efficiency through changes in property rights.

If open access persists, each individual's increased use of the resource would now adversely affect use by others, causing welfare losses. Users now have an incentive to “demand” a change in the property rights system, to a form that avoids these losses. This observation applies more generally: most market failures, such as externalities, public goods, and asymmetric information, afford the possibility to increase efficiency through changes in property rights.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 minimal과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: minimal ↔ enormous (최소의 ↔ 막대한)
det.analysis:
✅ ① enormous — 막대한 ←정답
❌ ② tiny — 아주 작은 (동의 뉘앙스)
❌ ③ similar — 비슷한 (의미축이 다름)
❌ ④ equal — 동등한 (관련 없음)
det.tip: common pool losses are minimal(손실이 최소의) ↔ enormous(막대한)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 persists와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: persists ↔ stops (지속되다 ↔ 멈추다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① continues — 계속되다 (동의어)
✅ ② stops — 멈추다 ←정답
❌ ③ spreads — 퍼지다 (의미축이 다름)
❌ ④ returns — 돌아오다 (관련 없음)
det.tip: If open access persists(개방 접근이 지속되면) ↔ stops(멈추다)

questions.passage:
(A) When a natural resource becomes scarce, the rights to use it begin to <u>matter</u> a great deal. Such rights are no longer a trivial issue for the community.
(B) Everything around us, from the air to a stone, is made of <u>matter</u>. Scientists study how this physical substance behaves under heat and pressure.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B) 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 matter의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ③ 중요하다 — 물질
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) begin to matter는 '중요해지다'라는 동사, (B) made of matter는 '물질'이라는 명사임 ←정답
❌ ① (A)는 '물질'이 아니라 중요하다
❌ ② (B)는 '문제점'이 아니라 물질
❌ ④ (A)는 '다루다'가 아니라 중요하다
det.tip: matter: (A) 중요하다(동사) / (B) 물질(명사)

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the health, happiness, and general well-being of a person or group"

det.korean: welfare (복지, 안녕)
det.analysis:
❌ ① poverty(가난): 복지와 반대되는 궁핍한 상태
❌ ② scarcity(희소성): 부족함을 뜻함
❌ ③ conflict(갈등): 사람 사이의 충돌
✅ ④ welfare(복지): 사람이나 집단의 건강·행복·안녕 ←정답
det.tip: welfare = 복지, 건강과 행복을 아우르는 안녕

questions.passage: The demand for property rights arises when groups or individuals realize that their welfare would be __________ (enhance) if the current property rights system were changed. Users now have an incentive to demand a change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: enhanced (would be + 과거분사, 수동태)
det.analysis: enhance(동사 원형) → enhanced: 조동사 would 뒤 be동사와 함께 'would be + 과거분사' 수동태를 이룬다. 복지가 '향상되는' 대상이므로 수동형 enhanced가 맞다.
det.tip: would be + 과거분사(수동태): would be enhanced(향상될 것이다)

questions.passage: If open access persists, each individual's increased use of the resource would now __________ (adverse) affect use by others, causing welfare losses. Users now have an incentive to demand a change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: adversely (형용사 → 부사)
det.analysis: adverse(형용사) → adversely: 뒤에 오는 동사 affect를 수식해야 하므로 부사형 adversely가 필요하다. '악영향을 끼치다(adversely affect)'라는 뜻이 된다.
det.tip: 동사 affect를 수식하는 부사: adverse → adversely

det.korean: 빈칸에 set in motion(시작되다, 작동되기 시작하다)이 적절. 자원이 희소해지면 재산권이 진화하는 과정이 '시작될' 수 있다는 문맥이다.

det.korean: 빈칸에 increase efficiency(효율성을 높이다)가 적절. 대부분의 시장 실패는 재산권 변화를 통해 '효율성을 높일' 가능성을 제공한다는 문맥이다.
det.analysis:

❌ ④ limit production — 생산을 제한하다 (문맥 무관)
